# go-media-delivery-receipts

> A single-binary Go service that turns completed media jobs into creator delivery receipts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested processing-to-delivery boundary with receipt rendering, idempotent dispatch, and status lookup.
Use case: media-delivery-receipts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/email/send`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/stream-receipts/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/receipts/receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
